static_traits.name: Lin Kexin
static_traits.educational_background: Studies at a renowned design school in New York
static_traits.social_status: has close friends' support, but has not yet confided in detail to friends/classmates for fear of judgment
static_traits.medical_history: no major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; never received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, capable of self-Reflection, fairly cooperative, calm tone with slight anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: I am passionate about fashion and dream of becoming a successful fashion designer, but I keep having the thought 'I will never have a career in fashion', and these thoughts have become more frequent since moving to New York for Learning, affecting my motivation to pursue my dream.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these persistent negative thoughts are hindering my progress in career ambitions and my passion for fashion.
growth_experiences: After moving to New York to live independently and entering a highly competitive prestigious school, stress increased markedly (independent living, competitive environment), and negative predictive thinking began to become frequent and intense.

despite successfully entering a prestigious design school and receiving professors' affirmation of the work, Persistent self-doubt from comparing with 'better people' in the industry, difficulty internalizing positive feedback as confidence.

core_beliefs: I will never succeed in the fashion industry
I am not good enough, unable to stand out in competition

special_situations.event: When working on a design project
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if my work cannot immediately show high standards and potential, it meansI am not good enough, unable to gain a foothold in the fashion industry
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: seeking friends' comfort and positive self-talk to ease unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: this has no meaning, I can never be good enough for this career

special_situations.event: When browsing fashion stores, looking for design inspiration
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if others are more talented than me, I have no chance of success
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids in-depth discussion with friends or classmates, reducing self-exposure to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: with so many people better than me, I cannot stand out

special_situations.event: After moving to New York, faces competition and independent-life pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I cannot quickly adapt and fully control the pace, I will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Restricts expressing real feelings and uses rational explanations to soothe himself to maintain functioning
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: the environment is too competitive, I cannot hold on, and will never succeed in the end

special_situations.event: When the professor praises my work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: only clear industry achievements count as competence, a single compliment does not represent real ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negating or downplaying positive feedback, continuing to maintain Self-doubt for the sake of 'caution'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: these compliments are just politeness, and do not mean I can succeed

core_conflict.wish: Longs for recognition and success; to gain a stable sense of self-worth
core_conflict.fear: fear of failure and judgment, worrying about being negated after exposing vulnerability
defense_goal: maintaining psychological safety through caution and Self-denial, reducing the risk of being negated
keeping emotions and expression restrained, avoiding appearing 'not good enough' in front of others

object_relations.self_representation: a newcomer who is not good enough and easily judged
object_relations.object_representation: picky others/peers who may negate oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when needing to share negative thoughts or uncertainty with friends or classmates
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: they will judge me like industry judges, thinking I am not serious enough or lack ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using cautious, vague expressions, reducing detail and emotional exposure; restrained tone, prioritizing objective facts over subjective vulnerability.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when asked for reasons while facing competitive pressure or uncertainty about work quality
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: expressing vulnerability would seem unprofessional, so Interpreting with objective factors is safer
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: emphasizing external competition and industry difficulty, replacing emotional expression with rational Interpretation; steady tone, avoiding self-disclosing words.

manifestations: having the thought 'this has no meaning' during design projects
difficulty internalizing positive feedback as a sense of worth, feeling efforts may be ineffective
living independently in New York, feeling greater responsibility for choices and the future
Facing autonomy pressure from a competitive environment
outcomes: Avoiding expression, shrinking social sharing, forming a negative cycle

manifestations: worrying about being judged and unwilling to confide negative thoughts to friends
Lacks the experience of genuine support and resonance at important moments
outcomes: negative thinking Reinforcement, confidence hard to build

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believes friends/classmates will judge them, thus reduces sharing
attributing Self-doubt experiences externally to others' possible attitudes

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Tends to suppress subjective emotional expression with objective reasons

Successfully entered a famous design school, with certain abilities and resources
Has received professors' affirmation; considerable positive evidence exists
Willing to seek help and start recording achievements (proactive help-seeking)
having a close-friend support network (though not yet fully used)

excessive comparison with others causing Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: repeated negative predictions about career prospects in design Learning and inspiration-seeking situations (e.g. 'I will never succeed'), accompanied by Decreased drive and behavioral sluggishness
antecedent: When visiting fashion stores or browsing industry news
When thinking about the competition and independent-living pressure in New York
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-doubt and catastrophic/predictive cognitions formed in a highly competitive environment, worry about judgment and failure leading to Reinforcement of negative Automatic thoughts
target_behavior.function: escaping anxiety and uncertainty (temporarily relieved by reducing exposure and sharing, seeking comfort)
target_behavior.consequence: LearningDeclining motivation and engagement, daily self-care affected, difficulty taking sustained Career development actions
